column5: Free boosts on YardSwaps: three ways to put your listing in front of more buyers without paying. Here is how each one works.

Open Account. The Free boosts card sits at the top. Tap How it works. A boost shows your listing ahead of unboosted ones in suggested results, for buyers whose distance and filters match. Boost time pauses while a listing is hidden and picks up when it is live again.

The Starter boost. Post four listings within fourteen days of your first, and every listing you have is boosted free for fourteen days. The card counts you up. Here the fourth listing goes in: one photo, the AI fills in the details, tap Use price, and publish. The Starter boost switches on.
Back in My Listings, every unit now carries the Starter boost, with the days left under each one. Anything you post while it runs is boosted too.

Boost credits. Every four listings you post earns a free seven day boost, up to five, and they never expire. When you publish, pick Free, seven days, and the listing goes live boosted. You can also spend one from the Boost button on any live listing.
Invite a seller. Share your invite code. Once their first listing has been live for three days, you both get a free seven day boost.
Free to list. Free boosts. YardSwaps, link below.
